answers.core: This is about to improve the Inspector usability out of the box for theme tweaking.
answers.workaround:
When getting the theme items as they are not overridden, we need to modify the `get_theme_*` methods to skip getting the override values.

This can be worked around with a plugin if the `get_theme_*` methods are modified, but it's not very convenient.

title: Display the actual used theme items in the Inspector
